Ch132 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 132)

Subject: metabolomics | ID: 47238

Theorem

For any finite-rank spectrum f on a Bergman space X, the set of regular values is of full measure in the target space by Sard's theorem.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the trace-class spectral family \(V_{01320011}\), the image is precompact in the BMO space topology.

Step 2. By the normal spectral theorem, we decompose \(S_{01320012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the normal spectral family.

Step 3. Applying the monotone interpolation theorem to \(P_{01320013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via rational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
